sections.title: Identity and form
sections.text: This catalogue entry depicts Calotropis procera, a large evergreen shrub, usually about 2.5–4 m tall and sometimes near 6 m. It has thick opposite leaves, waxy flowers with a purple centre, and an inflated follicle that releases silky-haired seeds. It is widespread in dry tropical Africa and Asia.

sections.title: Toxicity and image
sections.text: Its milky latex is irritating and toxic, especially to the eyes; no edible use is described. Traditional medicinal uses are not proof of safety or efficacy. The plate's opposite fleshy leaves, purple-centred flowers and follicle with tufted seeds fit the species.
